The dedicated scoped OAuth credential route is explicitly unqualified within this plan. It is permitted only when independently proved to meet the same isolation, egress, startup-check, and policy requirements as the pinned default relay pairing; no automatic route switch, ambient-credential fallback, or OAuth qualification claim is made here. Source: design.md line 19; planning-observations.txt line 1 ('Optional OAuth must meet the same containment policy; do not infer qualification or switch routes').
coverageLimitations.boundary: OAuth route requires separate route-specific qualification evidence before use; no claim of approval is made in this plan

coverageLimitations.detail: Native OS containment via Bubblewrap user namespaces is scoped to Linux/WSL. Non-Linux platforms support offline fixture packaging and synthetic exercise only and must not claim native namespace containment qualification. Source: design.md line 27 ('Linux/WSL confinement depends on host namespaces/runtime and filesystem primitives; refuse weaker fallbacks. Other platforms can package and exercise offline fixtures without claiming native support').
coverageLimitations.boundary: Linux/WSL-only Bubblewrap namespace isolation; non-Linux platforms excluded from live containment qualification
